{
  "$schema": "https://json.schemastore.org/claude-code-plugin-manifest.json",
  "name": "genshin-mods",
  "displayName": "Genshin Mods",
  "description": "Five Claude Code mods under one band above the prompt: waypoints (the next steps, one press each), resin (cache, context, limits and cost, with warm, compact and a one-click handoff), veil (recording mode), commission (a goal's task list and clock) and ward (a question before editing a file another session just changed).",
  "author": {
    "name": "Esposter",
    "url": "https://github.com/Esposter"
  },
  "homepage": "https://esposter.com/docs/infra/claude-interface/genshin-mods",
  "repository": "https://github.com/Esposter/Esposter",
  "license": "Apache-2.0",
  "keywords": [
    "cache",
    "collision",
    "genshin",
    "handoff",
    "mods",
    "recording",
    "tasks"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts"
}
